Table: development_programs
Description: Workforce development programs such as Leadership Development, Technical Upskilling, Mentorship, Career Development, and Manager Training.
Grain: One row represents one development program.
Primary key: program_id
Foreign keys:
None
Columns:
- program_id (VARCHAR): Unique program identifier.
- program_name (VARCHAR): Synthetic program name.
- program_type (VARCHAR): Program category such as Leadership Development or Mentorship.
- start_date (DATE): Program start date.
- end_date (DATE): Program end date.
- target_job_level (VARCHAR): Intended employee job level for the program.
- program_status (VARCHAR): Planned, Active, Completed, or Cancelled.
Sample rows:
- program_id=P001, program_name=Leadership Development 01, program_type=Leadership Development, start_date=2025-03-01, end_date=2025-06-01, target_job_level=L4, program_status=Completed

metadata.description: Workforce development programs such as Leadership Development, Technical Upskilling, Mentorship, Career Development, and Manager Training.
metadata.grain: One row represents one development program.

columns.name: program_type
columns.description: Program category such as Leadership Development or Mentorship.

columns.name: target_job_level
columns.description: Intended employee job level for the program.

Table: employee_programs
Description: Many-to-many bridge between employees and development programs, including enrollment status, completion date, and completion score.
Grain: One row represents one employee enrollment in one program.
Primary key: employee_program_id
Foreign keys:
- employee_id -> employees.employee_id
- program_id -> development_programs.program_id
Columns:
- employee_program_id (VARCHAR): Unique employee-program enrollment identifier.
- employee_id (VARCHAR): Employee enrolled in the program.
- program_id (VARCHAR): Development program identifier.
- enrollment_date (DATE): Date the employee enrolled.
- completion_date (DATE): Date the employee completed the program; null if not completed.
- participation_status (VARCHAR): Enrolled, In Progress, Completed, or Withdrawn.
- completion_score (DOUBLE): Synthetic completion score, null for incomplete enrollments.
Sample rows:
- employee_program_id=EP000001, employee_id=E00001, program_id=P001, enrollment_date=2025-03-10, completion_date=2025-05-28, participation_status=Completed, completion_score=88.5

metadata.description: Many-to-many bridge between employees and development programs, including enrollment status, completion date, and completion score.

Table: employees
Description: Synthetic employee records without names, emails, demographics, or other PII. Supports headcount, hierarchy, job level, location, and organization analysis.
Grain: One row represents one employee.
Primary key: employee_id
Foreign keys:
- organization_id -> organizations.organization_id
- manager_id -> employees.employee_id
Columns:
- employee_id (VARCHAR): Unique synthetic employee identifier.
- hire_date (DATE): Employee hire date.
- termination_date (DATE): Employee termination date, null when not terminated.
- employment_status (VARCHAR): Active, Terminated, or Leave.
- job_level (VARCHAR): Job level from L2 through L7.
- job_family (VARCHAR): Functional job family such as Data, Product, Finance, or HR.
- location (VARCHAR): Employee work region.
- manager_id (VARCHAR): Employee identifier for the manager; nullable for senior employees.
- organization_id (VARCHAR): Current organization assignment.
Sample rows:
- employee_id=E00001, hire_date=2022-04-12, termination_date=None, employment_status=Active, job_level=L4, job_family=Data, location=North America, manager_id=E00100, organization_id=ORG001

Table: internal_moves
Description: Employee internal mobility events including promotions, lateral transfers, organization transfers, and role changes.
Grain: One row represents one internal employee move event.
Primary key: move_id
Foreign keys:
- employee_id -> employees.employee_id
- from_organization_id -> organizations.organization_id
- to_organization_id -> organizations.organization_id
Columns:
- move_id (VARCHAR): Unique internal move identifier.
- employee_id (VARCHAR): Employee associated with the move.
- move_date (DATE): Date the internal move occurred.
- move_type (VARCHAR): Promotion, Lateral Transfer, Organization Transfer, or Role Change.
- from_organization_id (VARCHAR): Organization before the move.
- to_organization_id (VARCHAR): Organization after the move.
- from_job_level (VARCHAR): Job level before the move.
- to_job_level (VARCHAR): Job level after the move.
Sample rows:
- move_id=M000001, employee_id=E00001, move_date=2026-04-10, move_type=Promotion, from_organization_id=ORG001, to_organization_id=ORG001, from_job_level=L4, to_job_level=L5

metadata.description: Employee internal mobility events including promotions, lateral transfers, organization transfers, and role changes.
metadata.grain: One row represents one internal employee move event.

columns.name: move_type
columns.description: Promotion, Lateral Transfer, Organization Transfer, or Role Change.

Primary key: organization_id
Foreign keys:
- org_leader_id -> employees.employee_id

Table: talent_reviews
Description: Employee talent and performance review records for H1 and H2 review cycles from 2024 through 2026.
Grain: One row represents one employee review in one review cycle.
Primary key: review_id
Foreign keys:
- employee_id -> employees.employee_id
Columns:
- review_id (VARCHAR): Unique review identifier.
- employee_id (VARCHAR): Employee receiving the review.
- review_cycle (VARCHAR): Review cycle such as 2024_H1 or 2026_H2.
- review_date (DATE): Date associated with the review cycle.
- performance_rating (INTEGER): Performance rating from 1 through 5.
- potential_rating (INTEGER): Potential rating from 1 through 5.
- promotion_recommended (BOOLEAN): Whether the review recommended the employee for promotion.
- review_status (VARCHAR): Completed, Pending, or Cancelled.
Sample rows:
- review_id=R000001, employee_id=E00001, review_cycle=2026_H1, review_date=2026-06-15, performance_rating=4, potential_rating=4, promotion_recommended=True, review_status=Completed

metadata.description: Employee talent and performance review records for H1 and H2 review cycles from 2024 through 2026.
metadata.grain: One row represents one employee review in one review cycle.

columns.name: review_date
columns.description: Date associated with the review cycle.

columns.name: promotion_recommended
columns.description: Whether the review recommended the employee for promotion.
